list:
operant <cmd> [args] [--flag value] [--json]

  tiles: tiles, status, focus, close, ws, title
  terminals: run, test, build, read, send, wait, stop
  files: view, edit, diff, open
  browser: browse
  agents & tasks: agent, ask, notify, plan, task, board, team, summarize, find
  memory: remember, recall
  context: usage, compact
  misc: ports, watch

  operant help <cmd> for flags and examples.
  --json prints the raw JSON result instead of formatted text.
  read/wait: --new only output since your last read, --errors only error/warning lines with context, --grep <pattern> only matching lines, --digest a test/build summary+failures.

commands.tiles:
operant tiles

  list this window's tiles

Examples:
  operant tiles
commands.status:
operant status

  info about the calling tile

Examples:
  operant status
commands.focus:
operant focus <id>

  focus a tile

Examples:
  operant focus 7
commands.close:
operant close <id> [--force]

  close a tile

Examples:
  operant close 7
commands.ws:
operant ws [n] [--name n]

  switch/name workspace

Examples:
  operant ws 2
commands.title:
operant title <text...>

  retitle the calling tile

Examples:
  operant title "worker1"
commands.view:
operant view <path> [--focus]

  open a viewer tile (Markdown/code/images)

Examples:
  operant view plan.md
commands.edit:
operant edit <path>

  open an editor tile

Examples:
  operant edit foo.js
commands.diff:
operant diff [dir]

  open a changes tile

Examples:
  operant diff
commands.open:
operant open <target>

  open a file/folder/URL

Examples:
  operant open report.pdf
commands.run:
operant run <command...> [--title t] [--cwd c] [--focus]

  run a command in a new tile, stays open

Examples:
  operant run "npm run dev" --title dev
commands.test:
operant test [command...] [--cwd c] [--idle s] [--timeout s] [--json]

  run tests in a new tile (auto-detected if no command), wait, return a runner/summary/failures digest

Examples:
  operant test
  operant test "pytest -k foo"
commands.build:
operant build [command...] [--cwd c] [--idle s] [--timeout s] [--json]

  like test, for a build/compile command

Examples:
  operant build
  operant build "cargo build --release"
commands.read:
operant read <id> [--lines n] [--new] [--errors] [--grep p] [--digest]

  a tile's terminal output

Examples:
  operant read 7 --errors
  operant read 7 --digest
commands.send:
operant send <id> <text...> [--enter]  |  operant send [<claude-tile>] --file <brief> | --brief "<text>" [--new] [--team]

  type into a tile; with --file or --brief (a refined prompt) it puts the brief into the lead Claude tile of the project as its next message (or the tile you name; --new starts a fresh one), framed as from another agent on behalf of the user, and returns at once: a busy tile is never interrupted, the brief waits until it is idle; --team hands it over as team work (needs team mode)

Examples:
  operant send 7 "y" --enter
  operant send --file brief.md
  operant send 7 --file brief.md --team
commands.wait:
operant wait <id> [--idle s] [--timeout s] [--new] [--errors] [--grep p] [--digest]

  block until a tile goes quiet or exits, then read (same read filters, or a test/build digest)

Examples:
  operant wait 7 --idle 5
  operant wait 7 --digest
commands.stop:
operant stop <id>

  stop a tile's running agent/command

Examples:
  operant stop 7
commands.browse:
operant browse <url>

  open a URL in the default browser (follows Settings › Open links in)

Examples:
  operant browse localhost:3000
commands.agent:
operant agent <prompt...> [--agent id] [--tier xsmall|small|medium|high|max] [--model id] [--cwd c] [--title t]

  start a new agent tile with a prompt (a tier picks the agent+model and adds a board task; workers can't start their own workers)

Examples:
  operant agent "task..." --title worker
  operant agent "list the files in bin/" --tier xsmall
commands.ask:
operant ask <question...> [--options "A|B|C"] [--detail d]

  blocking dialog, returns the choice

Examples:
  operant ask "Delete old migrations?" --options "Delete|Keep"
commands.notify:
operant notify <text...> [--title t]

  Windows notification

Examples:
  operant notify "Tests pass, ready for review"
commands.plan:
operant plan <file.md>

  show a plan, block until Approve or Change (returns the note)

Examples:
  operant plan plan.md
commands.task:
operant task add "<text>" [--for id] | claim <id> | done <id> [--note n] | note <id> "<text>"

  add/claim/finish/note a board task

Examples:
  operant task add "fix the login bug"
  operant task claim 3
  operant task done 3 --note "fixed in login.js"
commands.board:
operant board [--full]

  list every task: id, status, owner, one-line summary (--full: whole text), last note

Examples:
  operant board
  operant board --full
commands.team:
operant team

  team mode: enabled/disabled, each tier (agent, model, use), running workers

Examples:
  operant team
commands.summarize:
operant summarize <file|tile-id|url> ["question"]

  an xsmall-tier worker reads it and answers, so you never load it yourself

Examples:
  operant summarize RELEASE_NOTES.md "what shipped in 1.10.0, 3 bullets"
  operant summarize 7 "why did it fail"
commands.find:
operant find "<question>"

  an xsmall-tier worker searches the project and answers with file:line references

Examples:
  operant find "where is the auto compact threshold checked"
commands.remember:
operant remember "<fact>" [--type user|feedback|project|reference] [--global] [--about "<file|symbol>[,<more>]"]

  save (or update) one fact in this project's shared memory; --type user/--global for user-wide facts; --about links it to code (resolved through CodeGraph when indexed)

Examples:
  operant remember "Ship on dev-<version>, fast-forward main at release" --type project
  operant remember "Prefers plain commit messages" --type user
  operant remember "recall() caps output around 2k tokens" --about memory.js,recall
commands.recall:
operant recall ["query"] [--about "<file|symbol>"]

  the memory index, matching facts for a query, or facts linked to a file/symbol

Examples:
  operant recall
  operant recall "release process"
  operant recall --about main.js
commands.usage:
operant usage [--breakdown] [--days 1|7]

  your tile's context size and the plan limits, or (--breakdown) where its project's tokens went

Examples:
  operant usage
  operant usage --breakdown
  operant usage --breakdown --days 7
commands.compact:
operant compact

  queue a progress note + compact for your tile's next idle moment

Examples:
  operant compact
commands.ports:
operant ports

  list dev-server URLs found in this window's tiles

Examples:
  operant ports
commands.watch:
operant watch <id> --errors [--grep p]

  notify (and tell the agent on its next call) on a new matching line in a tile (--off to stop, no id to list)

Examples:
  operant watch 7 --errors
  operant watch 7 --off
